description: Australian Aggregate Freight Forecasts (2019 and 2022 updates) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by BITRE. Members: Australian Aggregate Freight Forecasts - 2019 Update; Australian aggregate freight forecasts – 2022 update. Example entry: This report presents long-term forecasts of total Australian freight volumes, for road, rail, coastal shipping and aviation, between 2018 and 2040. Coverage is Australia, 2018 to 2050; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-11-14. Files and pages listed: HTML, PDF (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated); other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
